verdict.reasons: Image shows the correct AFP drip-tape carton roll with authentic, readable branding and the required watermark. The installed laterals in the background are standard supporting irrigation lines and consistent with the drip-tape use case. Minor advisory notes include small clearance between the roll and irrigation lines and minor crop-framing details, but no core defects are present.

focused_physical_review.reason:
1. clear_soil_gap: A broad, uninterrupted area of dry soil is visible surrounding the complete footprint of the package on all sides. 
2. line_touches_or_crosses_package: The visible black irrigation lateral lines are located far in the background and do not touch the package base, nor do they emerge from, disappear under, or cross the package footprint. 
3. extra_loose_product_coil: The only roll present is the single required white-and-blue AFP package; no distinct, additional loose uninstalled coils or rolls are visible. 
4. package_has_protruding_strip: The visible sides and base of the cylindrical package show smooth surfaces with no white ribbons, straps, or tape tails emerging or protruding.

acceptance_decision.source: user requested practical >=90 acceptance; actual saved vision evidence retained
